Sample.warning: The sample size was not reported in this section.

Country.evidence_source: Men meeting the inclusion criteria of (a) residing in Canada

Population.evidence_source: having lost a male friend, partner, or family member to suicide

Type.evidence_source: Digitally recorded interviews lasting between 60 to 90 minutes were conducted from 2014 to 2016 at a location and time convenient to the participants.

Area.evidence_source: The participants were also explicitly asked to share their views on masculinity and male suicide, including their perspectives about the high male suicide rates, and why male suicide in Western countries is 3 times higher than female suicide rates.
